# Ask an optional local assistant (models.ask)

## categories

[
  "models"
]

[
  {

    "id": "consult",
    "input": {
      "model_id": "llama-text",
      "prompt": "Give one limitation of using a single example to test a claim. Reply in one sentence."
    },
    "title": "Ask for a short critique"
  }
]

## description

Optionally delegate one bounded text-only subtask to an id discovered with models.list. Choose any configured model; none is preferred and consultation is never required. The supervisor checks the frozen model allowlist, permissions, exact digest, call budget, context, free memory and a single model lease. Models cannot call tools or recurse and their replies are untrusted data. No conversation history or media is shared automatically. The UTF-8 prompt byte guard plus output/framing reserves must fit configured context; models.list reports the effective limit. Output tokens include hidden reasoning where the model uses it; empty outputs are reported as failures. Calls may include cold loading, are timed/cancellable and consume one reservation even when they fail. A model server may finish cancellation/unload later; finite keep-alive bounds crash residency. The truncated flag reports a server length stop; partial text is not a completed subtask.

## failure_modes

[
  {
    "condition": "Budget exhausted or permission missing.",

    "symptom": "Denied consultation."
  },
  {
    "condition": "Server unavailable, timeout, identity mismatch or oversize output.",
    "recovery": "Treat the missing answer as missing evidence.",
    "symptom": "Recorded error; no substitute model."
  }
]

## limitations

[
  "Optional bounded text assistance, not an autonomous inhabitant or trusted advice.",
  "Configured profile order is stable by id and conveys no preference or quality ranking.",
  "Only the supplied prompt is shared. No tools, history, media inputs or host access.",
  "Memory admission is cooperative; model servers remain outside sandbox/job hard limits.",
  "models.ask failures, empty outputs and uncertain calls consume reservations; no retry or substitute."
]
